name: LEGO Horizon Adventure: Shield Weaver Outfit
storyline: The Horizon hero becomes a LEGO legend! Found as a baby in a cave and raised by a great machine hunter called Rost, Aloy is curious about her origins and sets off on a journey to discover her destiny. Along the way, she needs to take on a group of sun-worshippers and uncover ancient secrets as her personal quest grows into an epic battle to save the world.
summary: An outfit for LEGO Horizon Adventure based on the Horizon Zero Dawn outfit of the same name.
